title: A headless claude or opencode session out of usage hands off to the next account
description: Real dispatch with stub runtimes that exit at once on their provider's limit: claude's headless result "Switch to another model, or manage usage credits at https://claude.ai/settings/usage", and OpenCode's Z.AI error {"type":"provider.quota","message":"Weekly/Monthly Limit Exhausted. Your limit will reset at 2026-11-20 12:49:15","status":429} from a worker (bare, and nested in its JSON error event with the 429 code 1310 body, as the worker run prints it) and a reviewer. With the test clock fixed at 2026-11-20 12:00 UTC — after the reset the notice names — each account is held (the Z.AI one until 2026-11-20 04:49:15 UTC, the reset its own event named, in the notice's Beijing time), the work starts on another account, and no launch failure is recorded.
